{{Trail|Items|Unique Items}} {{TOCright|limit=2}}
'''Unique Jewelry''' are various accessories available in Skyrim that are generally found in fixed locations, unlike most of the equipment in the game, which are randomly generated or generic equipment (see [[Skyrim:Generic Magic Apparel|Generic Magic Apparel]]). 

Many of these items are quest rewards, although some of the most valuable quest rewards are listed at [[Skyrim:Leveled Items|Leveled Items]] (unique items, but with level-dependent statistics) and [[Skyrim:Artifacts|Artifacts]] (unusually powerful unique items with unique appearances and enchantments). For unique items that are needed to complete quests, please see the [[Skyrim:Quest Items|Quest Items]] article. For other unique items in the game, see the [[Skyrim:Unique Items|Unique Items]] article. For a list of the rest of the available jewelry, see the [[:Category:Skyrim-Jewelry|jewelry category]].
